changes: Promotes the accepted accepted validation build serialized SAB control and fresh-state reconciliation architecture to production.
Restricts normal SAB API identity reconciliation to the authoritative current generation and quarantines historical NewzDeck SAB engines instead of adopting them.
Removes only proven stale duplicate queue entries while preserving legitimate tracked re-downloads.
Bootstraps authoritative SAB misc configuration before launch and correctly parses SAB 5.x nested server configuration.
Serializes NewzDeck-to-SAB control traffic and shares one coherent Queue/History reader across Downloads and Automation completion monitoring.
Bounds cached SAB Queue/History fallback; stale cached state cannot indefinitely renew itself, trigger Pause/Resume recovery, or drive destructive queue reconciliation.

When the SAB control channel remains unreadable beyond the short coherence lease, Downloads shows an explicit refreshing/degraded state instead of presenting stale speed or Remaining values as current.
Provider runtime state is treated as unknown rather than zero when the SAB status request itself fails.
Ambiguous addlocalfile connection resets reconcile accepted SAB jobs without duplicate submission.
Copy Diagnostics now exports Queue/History reset, short-cache, degraded-snapshot, stale-snapshot suppression, and freshness/age counters.
The ambiguous-handoff event is renamed to 'Reconciled SAB job after submission/runtime handoff' for accurate diagnostics wording.
regression_guards: The verified validation end-to-end path Automation -> Queue -> SAB -> NNTP -> Completed -> Smart Import remains unchanged.
Unavailable Usenet releases still move to Failed and are remembered so Automation can try another candidate.
One-package-at-a-time presentation remains limited to one foreground Active package.
Stale SAB queue data cannot trigger engine Pause/Resume recovery.
Historical SAB generations with live work are quarantined, never adopted as the active engine.
v3.6.19 non-disruptive lifecycle recovery, v3.6.18 idle-aware pause handling, v3.6.17 canonical Downloads state, and v3.6.16 verified Remove/Cancel remain preserved.
name: Authoritative SAB & Fresh-State Reconciliation
